Open-ended (PAYG / rolling monthly) rental end-date resolution with a 365-day paint horizon
Rationale: filtering out NULL end_date rentals made an occupied vehicle render as free on every date (operator-reported bug)
Rationale: an Active rental past its end_date is still physically out, so the calendar keeps painting forward

Per-rental vehicle swap history with old/new vehicle joins

Void a stale unpaid payment link without touching the rental

Rationale: every surface reading the payments table is invalidated, whichever entry point voided the link
Tenant-wide weekend surcharge rule (percent plus configurable weekend days)
